description: This file is a header file defining interfaces and constants related to a mock vendor component used for testing purposes in the WLD (Wireless Local Device) project. It includes function prototypes for creating, registering, and destroying mock vendor instances, as well as checking for existing vendors.

methods.name: wld_th_mockVendor_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the mock vendor as a constant string.

methods.name: wld_th_mockVendor_create
methods.description: Creates a new mock vendor instance with the provided name.

methods.name: wld_th_mockVendor_register
methods.description: Registers the mock vendor and returns a pointer to the vendor_t structure.

methods.name: wld_th_mockVendor_vendor
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the vendor_t structure associated with the mock vendor.

methods.name: wld_mockVendor_destroy
methods.description: Deallocates and cleans up resources associated with the mock vendor.

methods.name: wld_mockVendor_areThereStillVendors
methods.description: Checks whether there are still vendors registered.
